area_three_classification.three_cells: three roots, or two roots and one upper cell attached to one of them

H147.statement: Exploit paired area-three support to prove a uniform critical arc gap, then address arbitrary-area coprime and noncoprime cycle profiles.

P147.statement: A sparse polynomial vanishing at the coprime slope root has an exact circular-arc lift D|R with |R|<2||P||_1*2^(LW/q); if all nonzero coefficients are odd, R is odd and nonzero.

P148.statement: The residue recurrence classifies every valid area-two profile as two roots or one root-edge pair; it also gives the two exact area-three shape families.

P149.statement: Every positive coprime slope profile of defect area at most two is impossible except the area-zero trivial cycle; the critical area-two large-q part depends on EXT05 and E36 supplies the finite remainder.

P150.statement: For fixed area A, support(Q)<=2A+1 and ||Q||_1<=3*2^A-2; every noncritical profile with nonzero sparse lift is excluded beyond an effective A-dependent length.

fixed_area_noncritical.boundary: P150 requires R(Q_a)!=0; arbitrary Q_a coefficients need not satisfy the odd-coefficient shortcut used for area two.

noncritical_area_two.boundary: |R|<12*2^(3L/4)<2^(L-1), checked already at L=19 and monotone

profile_recurrence.validity: a_(r-m)>=a_r for r>=m and a_(r-m+q)>=a_r-1 for r<m

reduced_polynomial: Q_a=1+(X-1)sum_r(2^a_r-1)X^r modulo X^q-2; A_a(gamma)=0 iff Q_a(gamma)=0.
slope_root: For uq+vL=1, gamma=2^u*3^v mod D and gamma^q=2, gamma^L=3.

sparse_arc.nonvanishing: distinct A_j and odd nonzero c_j make R odd
sparse_arc.width: W<=q-ceil(q/M) after deleting a largest circular gap

what_this_result_does_not_prove: It does not exclude area at least three, general noncoprime cycles, H89, H112, H72, or prove Collatz.
